key_insight: SIGMA propagates generative-model fitting uncertainty into validation, helping distinguish genuine mismodeling from finite-training-set error.
engineering_relevance: Uncertainty-aware validation can support more reliable use of learned background models in particle physics and other physical sciences.
method: Estimate densities with Gaussian mixture models whose fitting uncertainties are tractable.
Profile these uncertainties as nuisance parameters in a new goodness-of-fit test.
Replace an exact-model point null with a composite null that accounts for statistical fitting error.
evidence_signal: On a controlled 2D toy model and a collider QCD-background benchmark, including uncertainties allowed the same model to be trusted on test sets up to an order of magnitude larger than standard testing allowed.
watch_item: The interpretation of rejection depends on propagated uncertainties faithfully covering fitting error; the framework uses Gaussian mixture models rather than arbitrary generators.
paper_title: An end-to-end framework for uncertainty-aware validation of generative models
